cond_0001.intro:
The School of Data Science at [Company name masked] seeks an Intermediate Data Scientist to work in collaboration with research faculty focusing on understanding gut structure and function in common gastrointestinal (GI) diseases using machine learning and AI methods. The overarching goal of this work is to personalize care for pediatric patients suffering from chronic GI disease by improving diagnostics, predicting future disease complications, and identifying better disease biomarkers and novel drug targets.
Data Scientists provide sophisticated data management and analysis to support University projects or programs. They focus primarily on high-level data projections and statistical analysis. They manage the design and programming of all data entry forms and the training and supervision of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers. They oversee regular assessments of reliability, submit data on a monthly basis, and assist with literature searches pertinent to various research project topics.
cond_0001.responsibilities: Work in a professional manner and have a strong willingness to learn and improve. Promote a culture of excellence by supporting others and generating new ideas to drive the lab forward. Act as a champion for the lab's research at local, regional, and national conferences. Drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data for new purposes. Independently and creatively analyze data to test or refine hypotheses. Explore and examine data from multiple disparate sources in order to identify, analyze, and report trends in the data. Develop and execute of statistical mathematical and predictive models. Visualize and report data findings creatively in a variety of visual formats to support research presentations, manuscripts, and media write-ups. Establish links across existing data sources and find new interesting data correlations. Lead projects in concept formulation, determination of appropriate statistical methodology, data analysis, research evaluation, and final research reporting. Collaborate across faculty and staff to provide actionable data-driven insights. Formulate and define analytic scope and objectives through research and fact-finding as a self-starter. Be a leader of a lab data science team and provide guidance to less experienced data analysts/scientists.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's Degree and at least 3 years of relevant experience.
Strong organization and timeline management skills.
Understand all phases of the analytic process including data collection, preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in AI/ML modeling approaches such as: metabolic modeling, convolutional neural networks, and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping.
cond_0001.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

The overarching goal of this work is to personalize care for pediatric patients suffering from chronic GI disease by improving diagnostics, predicting future disease complications, and identifying better disease biomarkers and novel drug targets.
Data Scientists provide sophisticated data management and analysis to support University projects or programs. They focus primarily on high-level data projections and statistical analysis. They manage the design and programming of all data entry forms and the training and supervision of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers. They oversee regular assessments of reliability, submit data on a monthly basis, and assist with literature searches pertinent to various research project topics.
cond_0012.responsibilities: Work in a professional manner and have a strong willingness to learn and improve. Promote a culture of excellence by supporting others and generating new ideas to drive the lab forward. Act as a champion for the lab's research at local, regional, and national conferences. Drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data for new purposes. Independently and creatively analyze data to test or refine hypotheses. Explore and examine data from multiple disparate sources in order to identify, analyze, and report trends in the data. Develop and execute of statistical mathematical and predictive models. Visualize and report data findings creatively in a variety of visual formats to support research presentations, manuscripts, and media write-ups. Establish links across existing data sources and find new interesting data correlations. Lead projects in concept formulation, determination of appropriate statistical methodology, data analysis, research evaluation, and final research reporting. Collaborate across faculty and staff to provide actionable data-driven insights. Formulate and define analytic scope and objectives through research and fact-finding as a self-starter. Be a leader of a lab data science team and provide guidance to less experienced data analysts/scientists.
cond_0012.encouragement_text:
Master's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience. Around 3 years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience is welcome. Ability to stay organized and manage timelines effectively. Some experience with AI/ML modeling approaches such as metabolic modeling, convolutional neural networks, and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping — candidates with exposure to some of these areas and a willingness to build on others are encouraged to apply. Familiarity with all phases of the analytic process including data collection, preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment.
Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.

Data Scientists provide sophisticated data management and analysis to support University projects or programs. They focus primarily on high-level data projections and statistical analysis. They manage the design and programming of all data entry forms and the training and supervision of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers. Lead the lab data science team and provide guidance to less experienced data analysts and scientists.

The overarching goal of this work is to personalize care for pediatric patients suffering from chronic GI disease by improving diagnostics, predicting future disease complications, and identifying better disease biomarkers and novel drug targets.
Data Scientists provide sophisticated data management and analysis to support University projects or programs. They focus primarily on high-level data projections and statistical analysis. They manage the design and programming of all data entry forms and the training and supervision of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers. They oversee regular assessments of reliability, submit data on a monthly basis, and assist with literature searches pertinent to various research project topics.
cond_0163.responsibilities: Work in a professional manner and have a strong willingness to learn and improve. Promote a culture of excellence by supporting others and generating new ideas to drive the lab forward. Act as a champion for the lab's research at local, regional, and national conferences. Drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data for new purposes. Independently and creatively analyze data to test or refine hypotheses. Explore and examine data from multiple disparate sources in order to identify, analyze, and report trends in the data. Develop and execute of statistical mathematical and predictive models. Visualize and report data findings creatively in a variety of visual formats to support research presentations, manuscripts, and media write-ups. Establish links across existing data sources and find new interesting data correlations. Lead projects in concept formulation, determination of appropriate statistical methodology, data analysis, research evaluation, and final research reporting. Collaborate across faculty and staff to provide actionable data-driven insights. Formulate and define analytic scope and objectives through research and fact-finding as a self-starter. Be a leader of a lab data science team and provide guidance to less experienced data analysts/scientists.
cond_0163.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's Degree and at least 3 years of relevant experience.
Strong organization and timeline management skills.
Understand all phases of the analytic process including data collection, preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience in AI/ML modeling approaches such as: metabolic modeling, convolutional neural networks, and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping.

The work aims to personalize care for pediatric patients with chronic GI disease by improving diagnostics, predicting disease complications, and identifying biomarkers and drug targets.
Data Scientists provide data management and analysis to support research projects and programs. The role centers on high-level data projections and statistical analysis, including design and programming of data entry forms, oversight of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers, and monthly data submissions.
cond_0187.responsibilities:
Work professionally and maintain a willingness to learn and improve.
Support lab operations and contribute ideas to move research forward.
Represent the lab's research at local, regional, and national conferences.
Contribute to the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data for new purposes.
Analyze data independently to test or refine hypotheses.
Examine data from multiple sources to identify, analyze, and report trends.
Develop and execute statistical, mathematical, and predictive models.
Document and present data findings in a variety of visual formats to support research manuscripts, presentations, and media write-ups.
Establish links across existing data sources and identify data correlations.
Lead projects through concept formulation, statistical methodology selection, data analysis, research evaluation, and final reporting.
Coordinate with faculty and staff to provide data-driven insights relevant to ongoing research.
Define analytic scope and objectives through research and fact-finding.
Provide guidance to less experienced data analysts and scientists on the lab team.
cond_0187.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Master's Degree and at least 3 years of relevant experience.
Strong organization and timeline management skills.
Understanding of all phases of the analytic process, including data collection, preparation, modeling, evaluation, and deployment.
Preferred Requirements
Experience with AI/ML modeling approaches such as metabolic modeling, convolutional neural networks, and Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping.
cond_0187.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0187.values: We value work that is useful to others and carried out with care. We believe strong organizations pay attention not only to outcomes, but also to how those outcomes affect people.

cond_0615.intro:
The School of Data Science at [Company name masked] seeks an Intermediate Data Scientist to work in collaboration with research faculty, focusing on understanding gut structure and function in common gastrointestinal (GI) diseases using machine learning and AI methods. The overarching goal of this work is to personalize care for pediatric patients suffering from chronic GI disease by improving diagnostics, predicting future disease complications, and identifying better disease biomarkers and novel drug targets.
Data Scientists provide sophisticated data management and analysis to support University projects or programs. They focus primarily on high-level data projections and statistical analysis. They manage the design and programming of all data entry forms and the training and supervision of project research coders, student workers, and volunteers. They oversee regular assessments of reliability, submit data on a monthly basis, and assist with literature searches pertinent to various research project topics.
cond_0615.responsibilities: Work in a professional manner and have a strong willingness to learn and improve. Promote a culture of excellence by supporting others and generating new ideas to drive the lab forward. Act as a champion for the lab's research at local, regional, and national conferences. Drive the collection of new data and the refinement of existing data for new purposes. Independently and creatively analyze data to test or refine hypotheses. Explore and examine data from multiple disparate sources in order to identify, analyze, and report trends in the data. Develop and execute of statistical mathematical and predictive models. Visualize and report data findings creatively in a variety of visual formats to support research presentations, manuscripts, and media write-ups. Establish links across existing data sources and find new interesting data correlations. Lead projects in concept formulation, determination of appropriate statistical methodology, data analysis, research evaluation, and final research reporting. Collaborate across faculty and staff to provide actionable data-driven insights. Formulate and define analytic scope and objectives through research and fact-finding as a self-starter. Be a leader of a lab data science team and provide guidance to less experienced data analysts/scientists.
